caption:
One ordinary day on the French rail network: 9,455 scheduled train services, all moving at once.

Watch the network wake up before dawn, saturate at rush hour and empty again after midnight — every dot is a real service from the published timetable.

📊 See a full day of French rail traffic in this animated flow map, built from the SNCF Voyageurs GTFS timetable for Thursday 3 September 2026 — TGV INOUI, OUIGO, Intercités and TER, across 2,486 stations. Explore how Paris pulls the whole network, and when the country actually moves.

Source: SNCF Voyageurs GTFS, transport.data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte). Positions are interpolated between the published stops; the GTFS carries no track geometry, so stations are joined in straight lines.
